summary: Human Resources professional with the ability to work successfully with all levels of an organization, deliver expected results, consistently resolve issues, communicate sensitive information, identify opportunities for improvement and make suggestions for change.

education.institution: State University of New York, Albany

experience.title: HR Manager
responsibilities: Address employee and management questions, enforce collective bargaining agreements, and resolve work-related challenges.
Counsel employees on performance issues and coach managers on discipline and termination.
Facilitate management communication meetings and update senior management on company-wide HR matters.
Ensure onboarding of quality employees through effective recruiting processes and conduct new employee orientation.
Maintain legal compliance with federal and state HR requirements and conduct workplace investigations.
Consult on performance assessment, recognition programs, and talent reviews.
Develop affirmative action plans and implement HR-driven productivity programs.

experience.title: Sr. HR Generalist
responsibilities: Conduct initial service assessments and educate clients on workplace policies and employment laws.
Design employee handbooks, job descriptions, and act as liaison for payroll, benefits, and retirement plan issues.
Deliver training seminars and build strong client relationships to retain service base.

experience.title: HR Representative
responsibilities: Coordinate hiring and orientation programs and provide guidance on company policies.
Resolve labor relation issues with union representatives and develop training for management.
Manage employee recognition programs, prepare affirmative action plans, and maintain HR databases.

experience.title: Employment Specialist
responsibilities: Initiate hiring processes, use ATS to track candidates, and recommend new sourcing methods.
Create job postings, coordinate interviews, and present employment offers.
Conduct new hire orientation, prepare recruiting reports, and support EEO efforts.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Support management on employment issues, monitor wage structures, and recommend benefit plan changes.
Review resumes, conduct reference checks, and facilitate new hire orientation and exit interviews.
Administer 401K plan, process disability claims, and ensure compliance with labor laws.

experience.title: Human Resources Specialist
responsibilities: Coordinate recruitment and onboarding, facilitate performance appraisals, and administer FMLA policies.
Assist with employment law and union relations, develop training materials, and chair community events.

experience.title: Human Resources Coordinator
responsibilities: Conduct new hire orientation, process enrollment and terminations, and manage payroll-related information.
Support policy compliance, plan community events, and maintain employee personnel files.

experience.title: HR Assistant
responsibilities: Manage HRIS, assist with recruitment and orientation, and review policies and benefits.
Process disability claims, health insurance, and 401K enrollment, and maintain employee files.
